metrics.profile_summary: Award-winning Marketing Communications Leader with over 13 years of experience in data-driven strategies across traditional and digital platforms. Expert in leading cross-functional teams, optimizing budgets for ROI, and executing high-impact integrated campaigns.

experience.description: Leads end-to-end marketing for Square One Mall and Esquires Coffee; achieved 17.3% YoY footfall increase and 42.2% revenue growth through strategic annual calendars and budget management.
Managed digital and conventional advertising for Colgate Palmolive and MoneyGram; oversaw SEO, SEM, and paid campaigns across META, YouTube, and TikTok.
Managed large-scale events and activations for clients including British Petroleum and UBL Bank.
Provided brand consultancy and executed marketing campaigns for Bayer, Careem, and Philip Morris International.
Managed diverse portfolios including Unilever and Johnson & Johnson, handling TV, print, and outdoor advertising within strict budgets.
Developed and sold commercial air-time proposals to major clients like L’Oreal and Nestle.
Managed activation campaigns and annual calendars for National Foods and Continental Biscuits.

strengths: Proven track record with award-winning campaigns (Effie, Dragons of Asia)
Strong technical proficiency in GA and ad platforms
Deep experience in both agency and brand-side management
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a Manager-level role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, exceeding the experience requirements with 13+ years of expertise. He possesses all must-have skills (GA, ad reporting, communication) and a proven history of managing teams and budgets to drive significant revenue growth.
